messages:
sasha_cs: Heads up  Kestrel Labs renewal due in 12 days. Procurement is pushing back on the +9% list bump. They asked either: (A) 9-month bridge at current price, or (B) accept PO at current price if submitted by EOM. Also asked about consolidated invoice across NA/EU and VAT handling.
tyler_ae: Can Finance approve a 9mo bridge as a one-off? If yes I can escalate and try to get PO today.
revops: Policy: one-time 9-month price-protect amendment allowed for deals under $200k ARR if AE+CS provide exec-level confirmation and PO or signed amendment within 30 days. CC fallback ok for one invoice cycle. Revenue recognition requires signed docs or PO within 45 days.
mei_billing: For consolidated invoicing we need the legal name and VAT IDs for each entity. If they want Redwood EU on invoice, provide EU VAT ID and billing contact. Preferred PO template we gave procurement: 
```
PO: KES-2026-401
Vendor code: 66021-RW
Billing entity: Redwood Inc. or Redwood EU Services Ltd.
Billing contact: ap@kestrel.com
```
hana_legal: If we do the 9mo amendment I can draft a 2-sentence addendum today: term dates + price protection clause. Include a line: "if PO is received before EOM and contains vendor code, Company will honor PO pricing". Also include VAT/billing fields so AP doesn't chase.
sasha_cs: Customer says vendor-code creation often lags ~10 days. They'll try for PO today but asked if we can send the amendment now and accept PO later.
tyler_ae: I'll push procurement for PO now. If they stall, are we good to send DocuSign amendment and allow CC fallback?
revops: Yes CC fallback allowed for one invoice cycle while PO is processed. AE must upload exec confirmation email and set collection milestones in the ticket. Finance will not treat revenue as committed until PO or signed amendment is received within policy windows.
sasha_cs: Thanks. Hana, can you draft the amendment with billing fields? Mei, please paste the PO template so I can send it to procurement. I'll post updates here. :pray:
